article.story: BEAUMONT, Texas -- — Adam Hamilton had 16 points and Ja'Sean Jackson added a double-double in Lamar's 72-58 victory over Incarnate Word on Monday night. Hamilton added eight rebounds for the Cardinals (9-6, 4-0 Southland Conference). Jackson totaled 15 points, 10 assists, five rebounds and five steals. Cody Pennebaker scored 12 on 6-for-11 shooting. Shon Robinson and Davion Bailey both scored 16 to lead the Cardinals (9-6, 2-2). Robinson added six rebounds. Jalin Anderson pitched in with 10 points and five assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
